changes.description: On the standard Inspector and dialog (experiment 186): its name, its two inputs, one sentence and Configure…, which holds the unit and the conditions a candidate must meet, and what the last run measured. And its result is a table where a table is wanted (experiment 197): Relate, Select rows and Table read it keyed by point_id, nearest_id and the nearest candidate's own attributes as nearest_<attribute>, the distance as the value. It replaces Assign projection site in the sea-level example.

evidence.note: Repository regression coverage exists; this release entry does not certify a widget independently. 0.6.0: tests/distances-as-table.test.mjs checks the table and that a table port takes a distances result; tests/sea-level-from-scratch.browser.mjs builds both sea-level workflows on it (Chromium).
